name: Farm cottage with barn and dovecote
description: Norman farm range, 20 x 7.8 m under one tiled roof: a rendered cottage (kitchen with hearth, living room, ceiled) joined by a doorway to a rubble-stone barn open to the rafters with an earth floor and double cart doors, and a round stone dovecote turret with pigeon holes and a conical roof at the barn's rear corner.
